source_supported_observations.observation: Mission 3DE authorizes only local/no-spend, no-training, no-mutation diagnosis of the completed M3DD scaffold fit result.

The M3DE prompt forbids training, fitting, optimizer construction for fitting, backward passes, checkpoint creation, Brev commands, source/register mutation, manifest/tensor mutation, export, browser activation, model-card promotion, final-gate weakening, unsupported recognition claims, and push.
M3DD completed the single authorized bounded local fit/evaluation and selected continue_no_training_local_fit_result_diagnosis_after_scaffold.

The M3DD command used model_id asl-pilot-popsign-fresh5-m3dc-local-fit-motion-region-token-temporal, architecture scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1, seed 20260519, AdamW, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.0, no augmentation, batch size 4, 12 epochs, max_train_batches 32, max_validation_batches 32, checkpoint_selection best_validation, and PyTorch on mps.
The selected checkpoint policy was best_validation, selected epoch 11, with selected validation accuracy 0.2, validation loss 1.612093635559082, 32 batches, and 125 examples.
The training history recorded train accuracy between 0.144 and 0.2, final train accuracy 0.184, and validation accuracy 0.2 for every epoch.
Validation and test both produced top1_accuracy 0.2, macro_f1 0.06666666666666668, and confusion matrices with every example predicted as morning.
Per-label recall was 1.0 for morning and 0.0 for home, pen, thank_you, and who on both validation and test.
Threshold calibration selected threshold 1.0 with validation selected metrics coverage 0.0, accepted_accuracy 0.0, correct_pass_rate 0.0, false_accept_rate 0.0, and false_pass_rate 0.0.
The sidecar contains confidence, top2_confidence, probability_margin, and entropy, but does not retain raw logits or full per-class probability vectors.

Validation predicted_label distribution was morning:125 and top2_label distribution was thank_you:125; mean confidence was 0.22545262563228607, mean top2_confidence was 0.2046035439968109, mean margin was 0.020849081635475157, and mean entropy was 1.6067764530181885.

Test predicted_label distribution was morning:125 and top2_label distribution was thank_you:125; mean confidence was 0.22535577523708344, mean top2_confidence was 0.2047111543416977, mean margin was 0.020644620895385744, and mean entropy was 1.6067868156433105.

Read-only inspection shows best_validation checkpoint selection stores the best validation state when validation accuracy improves or ties with lower loss; for M3DD, epoch 11 was selected over epoch 12 because validation accuracy tied at 0.2 and epoch 11 had lower loss.

Read-only inspection shows evaluation loads checkpoint['model_state'], builds the checkpoint architecture, evaluates validation/test splits, then calibrates threshold from validation predictions and computes test threshold metrics at the selected threshold.
Read-only inspection shows prediction examples derive confidence from softmax top-1 probability, top2_confidence from topk, probability_margin as top1 minus top2, and entropy from the softmax vector.

M3CS recorded validation accuracy flat at 0.2, validation/test prediction collapse to morning:125, top-2 collapse to thank_you:125, and threshold behavior downstream of low-confidence near-uniform outputs on the earlier late-fusion TCN path.
M3CT found train, validation, and test predictions collapsed to the same near-uniform morning/top2-thank_you ordering and selected a train-split logit/feature separability packet.
M3CU found train-split features near-constant and nonseparable, making a last-layer-only explanation unlikely for the earlier late-fusion TCN path.
M3CV localized earlier late-fusion collapse before LayerNorm/readout at fused head input and selected a no-training architecture/data generalization failure packet.

M3CW classified the strongest explanation for the earlier late-fusion path as current_scratch_architecture_optimization_generalization_failure_under_existing_input_and_data_envelope and selected strategy escalation.
The browser model card remains status not_trained with sha256 00328c469536d6230a3c43c521f8aad68dfc05ef21fc0c0ad4a92421b54f894a.
The active vocabulary claim remains modelVersion rawframe-not-trained with activeLabels [] and evidenceArtifacts [], sha256 a8e269d0e79b50696c46bb728399acbf295c05c6ec962d6738c93f3a9bbc6546.

reviewer_inference: The M3DD failure is not explained by a simple reporting or artifact mismatch at the inspected level: command, model id, architecture, seed, manifests, checkpoint policy, and artifact hashes align with the M3DD receipt and output artifacts.

The M3DD failure is not explained by threshold calibration alone. Threshold selection is downstream of top-1 collapse because the validation/test predictions are already single-class morning before thresholding.

The M3DD failure is not explained by selected checkpoint epoch versus final epoch. The selected epoch 11 and final epoch 12 both sit on a flat 0.2 validation-accuracy trajectory, and train accuracy remains at chance-level rather than showing overfit hidden by checkpoint selection.

The strongest local diagnosis is renewed prediction-confidence collapse on the revised scaffold path: all held-out examples choose the same top-1/top-2 classes with very low margins and entropy near the five-class uniform entropy ln(5).

The M3DD scaffold result confirms the M3CS-level output-collapse diagnosis on a materially different architecture/input scaffold, but it does not yet reproduce the M3CT-M3CV raw-logit, train-split, and feature-representation localization for this new checkpoint.

Data/split/source generalization failure and architecture/input limitation remain plausible higher-level explanations, but the next local evidence gap is narrower: the M3DD sidecar lacks raw logits and full per-class probability vectors needed to compare the scaffold's class-ordering, probability spread, and split consistency against M3CT.

metric_trajectory_diagnosis.diagnosis: No epoch shows a local learning signal; train accuracy never rises above chance, and validation accuracy is flat at chance.

checkpoint_selection_diagnosis.diagnosis: The selected checkpoint is consistent with the code path because epoch 11 tied all other epochs on validation accuracy and had the lowest validation loss. This does not change the learning conclusion because all validation accuracies were 0.2.

prediction_distribution_diagnosis.diagnosis: The scaffold checkpoint produces stable low-margin morning top-1 and thank_you top-2 predictions across held-out splits. The entropy values are close to ln(5), which is consistent with near-uniform five-class softmax outputs.

threshold_behavior_diagnosis.diagnosis: Calibration avoids false passes only by selecting a threshold that accepts no examples. This is downstream of top-1 collapse and does not create recognition evidence.

artifact_command_consistency.diagnosis: No reporting/artifact mismatch is visible from the inspected files.

m3cj_m3cr_comparison.diagnosis: M3DD did not improve any required metric or avoid the known single-class collapse.

m3cs_to_m3cv_comparison.m3cs: Late-fusion TCN result diagnosis found flat 0.2 validation accuracy, validation/test morning:125 collapse, top2 thank_you:125 collapse, and threshold behavior downstream of low-confidence near-uniform outputs.
m3cs_to_m3cv_comparison.m3ct: Late-fusion prediction confidence/logit packet found the train, validation, and test splits collapsed to the same near-uniform morning/top2-thank_you ordering.
m3cs_to_m3cv_comparison.m3cu: Late-fusion train-split logit/feature separability packet found near-constant, nonseparable train features and did not support a last-layer-only explanation.
m3cs_to_m3cv_comparison.m3cv: Late-fusion representation packet localized collapse before LayerNorm/readout at fused head input.
m3cs_to_m3cv_comparison.m3dd_change: The revised scaffold changes the architecture/input scaffold but still reproduces the M3CS-level held-out output collapse. It has not yet reproduced M3CT-M3CV raw-logit or feature-localization diagnostics for the new scaffold checkpoint.
m3cs_to_m3cv_comparison.diagnosis: M3DD confirms that the failure is not unique to the old late-fusion TCN output surface. The next smallest local evidence gap is scaffold-specific confidence/logit distribution rather than another fit.

reporting_or_artifact_mismatch.reason: Recorded command, artifact hashes, model id, architecture, manifests, seed, and checkpoint-selection policy align.

train_eval_checkpoint_issue.reason: The selected checkpoint follows the documented best_validation tie/loss rule, and every epoch has validation accuracy 0.2.

threshold_or_calibration_only_issue.reason: Top-1 prediction collapse exists before thresholding; threshold 1.0 is fail-closed behavior downstream of collapse.

logits_confidence_collapse.reason: Both held-out splits have single-class top-1, single-class top-2, mean confidence near 0.225, mean margin near 0.021, and entropy near five-class uniform entropy.

data_split_source_generalization_failure.reason: Prior split/source/tensor diagnostics reduce simple leakage, label, source, and tensor explanations; M3DD train accuracy also remains chance-level, so this is not merely held-out generalization.

architecture_input_limitation.reason: M3DD reproduces collapse after a revised scaffold and prior M3CW evidence already pointed to architecture/optimization/input/data envelope failure for the old path.

code_path_review_need.reason: Read-only checkpoint/evaluation path inspection matched recorded behavior; no code defect was found in this slice, but a future no-training logits packet may require code support if raw logits are not retained.

decision.rationale: The diagnosis is complete enough to reject another fit/compute/export path now. The next smallest useful evidence gap is a no-training scaffold-specific prediction-confidence packet that captures raw logits or full per-class probabilities for the M3DD checkpoint and compares split/class ordering against M3CT before any feature packet, strategy escalation, or STOP decision.
